mixing_cause.summary: run_20261125_070347 was originally claimed with --priority P2_remaining (commit 79249b51), which fell into the unfiltered else (ALL) branch of scripts/claim-phase3-batch.mjs and included 39 P3_unverified_genres videos alongside 96 P2_verified_5_genres videos. Commit eb1cd90b subsequently renamed only the priority label to P2_verified_5_genres without re-filtering the ID list.
mixing_cause.data_integrity_note: prepare-phase3-batch.mjs and evaluate-phase3-batch.mjs classify each video individually via classifyVideoForCalibration(), so all 135 rows in phase3_batch_payload.json and TiDB carry accurate calibrationStatus (96 calibrated_verified, 39 calibrated_unverified_genre) and calibrationGenreBucket values. The existing report and payload files were intentionally left unmodified.
